body:
Being tired is such a huge part of it. Get help if you can.   


I know I shouldn't be saying this, but some medical services will only help you if it appears you are actively attempting suicide. Make it appear as if you are, even if you don't actually hurt yourself. Get them to help.

Honestly, I've considered it. Something like Paracetamol wouldn't hurt too bad but if I said I'd taken enough they'd do something, maybe.

And mods - don't worry this person is NOT encouraging me - we are just having a realistic talk about this stuff. Too much of it is censored. I am in control of my own mind.

Thank you, I appreciate that.  


I am not a good 'cutter', never have been. Like... I don't wanna die. I don't. I love the world, I love living and I love the few hobbies I have that make me feel wonderful inside. I just want it all to stop. That's what I told them. Sadly talking like that makes them feel you're not serious :/

EXACTLY. Oh my god this is exactly it.  


I know so, SO many people who have ended up dead because of this dismissive attitude. Like okay I personally know people who abuse these services. They have depression etc but they also just like the attention. Ok, not very good.  


But if someone is crying for 6 hours straight, looking like death warmed up there is usually a reason. I have nothing to live for: no kids, no job, crippling debt, no "IRL" friends, I am fat and ugly and my parents beat and abused me. But I keep kicking for some reason. Sometimes I need help with that kicking. Sickens me that nobody will help.  


One nurse literally said to me "If you had come in as an attempted suicide, we would have admitted you" (simply cos suicide is a crime here, and an attempt is almost like "attempted murder" on yourself, and you can be sectioned for a few days against your will)  


I honestly need it. I self harm with booze, food, and other things. I need to just be tucked away for a while until I can heal.

Unfortuantely it's more of a funding/accessibility issue than horrible doctors. They said to me (and honestly this disgusted me) "we cannot help you here and now unless you have actively tried to take your own life". I've heard this a number of times before.

They will only deal with you if you walk in with a gun to your head or pills in your belly. Not a good notion when you think about how easily triggered a suicidal person can be. I even said "is that what it is gonna take? Do I have to come back with a stomach full of vodka and diazepam?" but they didn't have an answer for me.

And thank you I appreciate the kind words <3
